scope: Synthetic human artificial chromosome centromere maintenance; HAC120/HAC465 2-kb barcode profiles and source-constrained causal follow-up

claims.statement: The raw pooled D1:D2 H3K9me3/CENP-A cross-odds cancels arbitrary shared within-domain per-tag copy weights.
claims.assumptions: Only the asserted shared-copy factor; tag copy weights and occupancies can vary across codes.
claims.novelty_boundary: The pooled statistic is a withdrawn computation, not a scientific claim. The deterministic witness has raw Phi=9.90198 and equal-tag per-copy Phi=1 at epsilon=0.001.
claims.costs: Arithmetic witness is constant-size; no biological data acquisition.
claims.falsifier: Not applicable after explicit algebraic counterexample; only added equal-copy/proportional-occupancy constraints could rescue a restricted aggregate identity.
claims.next_gate: Do not use pooled values for copy-normalized interpretation; use tagwise ratios or independently measured copy-normalized per-tag occupancy.

claims.statement: For same-tag phase folds, stable per-tag assay bias and copy number cancel; the D1-minus-D2 mean cancels marker/phase-wide multiplicative recovery factors. The H3K9me3-minus-CENP-A interaction also cancels tagwise copy shifts if the H3K9me3 and CENP-A aliquots share the same tagwise copy-ratio vector.
claims.assumptions: One effective copy weight per code or a phase-invariant copy-weighted occupancy mixture; tag-specific assay bias stable within marker; domain tag sets fixed; for the H/C interaction, equal phase/reference tagwise copy shifts across marker aliquots.
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a corrected measurement invariant, not a biological mechanism or proof that the assumptions hold in these samples.
claims.costs: Computes equal-tag log folds. Current estimates use one PC library per marker-condition and partial assemblies; no biological variance, complete per-phase DNA copy data, or same-cell state is acquired.
claims.falsifier: Condition-specific copy/structure or marker-aliquot mixture mismatch exceeding the explicit bias bound; tag-specific recovery changes; duplicated physical copies with phase-varying mark states.
claims.next_gate: Complete HAC structure, matched input DNA from each marker aliquot, and biological replicates; use the provided exact copy mismatch sensitivity bound.

claims.statement: Under the tagwise cancellation assumptions, the HAC120 D1-D2 H3K9me3:CENP-A phase-shape interaction is Phi=1.98745 (95% read-count-only interval 1.827-2.162) for COL vs THYM and Phi=1.47345 (1.361-1.596) for CR3 vs THYM. HAC465 D3-D4 gives Phi=1.17080 (1.013-1.353) and 1.90423 (1.638-2.213), respectively.
claims.assumptions: Source-defined tag intervals, tagwise algebra assumptions in C8-COPY-TAGWISE-02, Poisson/delta technical read-count approximation.
claims.novelty_boundary: Source-reported phase observations and their local reconstruction are not discovery of a kinetic law, absolute occupancy, centromere function, or HAC retention. Opposite COL-to-CR3 trajectories between HAC lines reject a single clone-independent relaxation interpretation.
claims.costs: Reads five public GEO archives and partial assemblies; calculation is local and constant time. Read intervals omit biological replicate, synchronization, clone-mixture, copy-structure, and assembly uncertainty.
claims.falsifier: An independent biological replicate with matched structure/copy normalization fails to reproduce the within-line tagwise interaction; or interval/structure checks reveal a sufficient marker-aliquot composition bias.
claims.next_gate: Replicate within clone using condition-matched DNA inputs and complete assembly; hold one clone out of any model fit.

claims.statement: H3K9me3-associated chromatin can constrain CENP-A domain movement and ectopic CENP-A/CENP-C domain formation in human centromeres; CENP-A loss can independently expose centromeric replication stress and structural instability.
claims.assumptions: Source-specific experiments in the studied human cell/centromere contexts; transfer to a distinct synthetic HAC is not presumed.
claims.proof_or_counterexample: Source records in sources/README.md; model boundary discussed in proof/BOUNDARY_MODEL_AND_DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.md.
claims.novelty_boundary: Both mechanisms are prior art. The new program would need to connect the 2-kb HAC trajectory to functional kinetochore multiplicity and structural integrity in the exact HAC clone.
claims.costs: Requires spatial chromatin assays, functional kinetochore imaging, replication-stress assays, and structure-resolved validation.
claims.falsifier: The boundary/replication effects fail to replicate in the synthetic construct or are explained by host-wide effects/selection rather than HAC-local mechanism.
claims.next_gate: Measure CENP-A, H3K9me3, CENP-C plus KNL1/NDC80, replication, and structural state as separate endpoints.

claims.statement: The supplied THYM/COL/CR3 cross-sectional PC profiles do not identify a spatial H3K9me3 invasion/reload law, front velocity, local replication-age lag, or domain-spacing threshold.
claims.assumptions: Unmeasured local recruitment/replication forcing is not fixed by the observed endpoints; samples are distinct synchronized aliquots rather than repeated measurements of one clone lineage.
claims.novelty_boundary: This is an identifiability limitation, not a new biological mechanism. 2014 replication evidence is explicitly construct-dependent and cannot supply the missing local timing for the 2026 barcode HAC.
claims.costs: No new data acquired; proof uses a free-forcing alias construction. To resolve requires local replication-timing and within-cycle sampling plus intervention.
claims.falsifier: An external constraint on local forcing/recruitment and a within-clone, replication-resolved time course that makes the dynamic parameters identifiable.
claims.next_gate: Map replication completion for each barcode and fit/predict held-out spatial timepoints under preregistered local model.

claims.statement: A phase-gated, barcode-targeted HJURP/KAT7 recruitment strategy that preserves flanking H3K9me3 may improve core reload without creating additional functional kinetochores; the two active cores may instead need coordinated recruitment.
claims.assumptions: Unique guide target sites; recruitment can be phase-gated without perturbing replication or cell cycle; functional kinetochore foci and structure can be measured; candidate dynamics hold within a specified clone.
claims.novelty_boundary: Early-G1 HJURP loading, KAT7/HJURP roles, and HAC chromatin tethering are prior art. Only the domain-resolved pulse plus one-kinetochore topology and structure readouts are untested here; no discovery/priority claim is made.
claims.costs: Factorial clone engineering, equal-dose phase-controlled perturbations, matched-input barcode sequencing, single-cell IF/FISH, kinetochore imaging, long-read/PFGE structure checks, and selection-free passage. A full 8-timepoint 4-arm 3-replicate 2-mark ChIP design at 2e7 cells/sample would use 3.84e9 cell-assays before controls; pilot a lower-input assay if validated.
claims.falsifier: Equal-dose late-G1 pulse performs as well as early-G1 pulse; core CENP-A/H3K9 profiles do not respond in biological replicates; extra CENP-C/KNL1 foci, boundary erosion, or structural loss rises despite apparent mark recovery.
claims.next_gate: Within each structure-admitted clone, randomize sham/D1/D2/both target arms and early/late pulses; measure mark profiles, local replication, KIN foci, anaphase missegregation, and structural loss independently.

claims.statement: Under a uniform vulnerable-run, fixed-boundary, n=1 autocatalytic H3K9 screening model, low-occupancy invasion has dominant growth rate lambda_m = a q - gamma - 4 D sin^2(pi/(2(m+1))); this yields a run-length-dependent CENP-A deficit threshold.
claims.assumptions: q=1-C/C_star in [0,1]; effective nearest-neighbor coupling D; deficit-linked linear H3K9 amplification a; clearance gamma; uniform block of m 2-kb codes with Dirichlet low-H3K9 endpoints; logistic saturation beyond the linearized low-occupancy state.
claims.novelty_boundary: The finite-path eigenvalue calculation is standard mathematics and the underlying centromere-boundary biology is prior art. The untested contribution is a replication-age-conditioned estimate that predicts held-out H3K9 edge motion and one-versus-multiple kinetochore topology in this synthetic HAC. No model parameters or numerical threshold are source-established.
claims.costs: Current source profiles cannot estimate D, a, gamma, or local replication age. Requires complete clone structure, phase-matched input, barcode-resolved replication and chromatin time courses, and separate functional-kinetochore/structural outcomes.
claims.falsifier: After estimating parameters in training timepoints/one clone, the model fails to predict held-out boundary motion; replication-age alignment does not change the fitted dominant growth sign; or predicted boundary instability fails to precede K>1 or structural loss.
claims.next_gate: Compare matched-dose fixed early-G1 and barcode replication-age-aligned HJURP/KAT7 pulses; fit on one clone and predict the other, while independently measuring CENP-C plus KNL1/NDC80, missegregation, and DNA structure. If feedback is superlinear with n>1, replace the linear eigenvalue gate with a measured finite-nucleus threshold.
